name: Miwa Yoshiko
source:
Grandmother of Shinjiro's wife Mari. She is cheerful and sociable. 

Her husband passed away three years ago.  She has many hobbies and still goes out often. 

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_130.html#character]official site[/url]]
